data.title: Belgrove Residences
data.about:
Belgrove Residences Meydan by Ellington Properties is the pinnacle of architectural excellence, offering meticulously designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments that redefine luxury off-plan living in Meydan Horizon. Inspired by the elegance of flamingos, this development combines beauty, balance, and innovation. Located in a prime spot, Belgrove Residences features breathtaking views of Ras el Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, Downtown, and Creek Skylines. Ellington Belgrove Residences Dubai offers world-class amenities, including a sky lounge, resort-style pool, fitness center, and kids' play areas, ensuring a balanced lifestyle for all ages.

This exclusive community provides not only luxury living but also practical convenience. Belgrove Residences' location ensures easy access to Meydan's vibrant surroundings, while its flexible payment plan makes it an attractive investment in one of Dubai's most sought-after areas. Ellington Properties' commitment to quality is evident in every detail, from the high-end finishes to the comprehensive living experience. Belgrove Residences at Meydan truly offers an unparalleled lifestyle, combining the best of urban sophistication and natural beauty

characteristics_module.title: Belgrove Residences: Elegance Redefined by Ellington
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Stunning views of Ras el Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, Downtown Skyline, and Creek Skyline.
  • Luxury Living: 210 elegant units with 1, 2, and 3 bedrooms, featuring modern finishes and high-quality materials.
  • World-Class Amenities: Sky lounge, cinema room, resort-style pool, rooftop club lounge, yoga studios, and state-of-the-art fitness center.
  • Family-Friendly: Dedicated kids' play areas, pet-friendly spaces, and retail options.
  • Exclusive Community: Situated in Meydan, known for luxury, green spaces, and the iconic Meydan Racecourse.

location_tile.title: The Best Location in Meydan!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Belgrove Residences Meydan by Ellington Properties is strategically located near the proposed metro line, offering easy access to Dubai's key destinations. This luxurious development provides residents with direct access to a stunning crystal lagoon and is adjacent to the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, blending urban convenience with natural beauty. The community is also close to top schools and retail shops, making it a perfect, self-sustained environment for families. Meydan is known for its unique combination of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities, providing a tranquil yet accessible lifestyle.

06 Minutes From Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
09 Minutes Dubai International Airport
10 Minutes from Burj Khalifa/ Dubai Mall
22 Minutes Burj Al Arab/ Burj Khalifa
28 Minutes from Palm Jumeirah
